snippet.title: HELLCAM Demo | This New Backrooms Game Looks Great | PC
snippet.description:
HELLCAM Demo | This New Backrooms Game Looks Great | PC
#backrooms #liminalspace #gameplay #gaming #indiegame 

Download Demo - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3222490/HELLCAM/

HELLCAM is an indie psychological horror exploration game developed in Unreal Engine 5. You wont find any lackluster objectives, instead oppressive liminal spaces are designed in order to make you feel stranded.

Wish listing HELLCAM allows you to receive a notification when it releases.

Explore multiple different ultra-realistic and stranded liminal spaces throughout the game, some places seeming more familiar then others.

In HELLCAM, you follow a backrooms researcher through the lens of a VHS camera. As you explore the unsettling, endless halls, you uncover the dark truth behind a corrupt corporation that sends its workers into the backrooms, knowing they’ll never make it out.

Experience an immersive journey with the classic look of the 1980s, combined with the Unreal Engine 5 engine to create a hyper-realistic expedition.
